finding: Download and File details sheets have no dialog semantics (no role=dialog, no aria-modal, no accessible name)

environment.engine: Chromium via Playwright, mobile emulation (iPhone Safari 17 UA), deviceScaleFactor 2

repro: Open the public demo view URL at 320x568.
Tap the download icon (#wt-m-export) to open the Download sheet, or the … menu -> File details.

whatAlreadyWorks.tabOrderStaysInsideSheet: 8 consecutive Tab presses all stayed inside the sheet (cycles back to the first format button)

measured.whyItMatters: VoiceOver/TalkBack are not told a modal dialog opened, and the page behind stays in the accessibility tree, so a screen reader keeps reading background content while the sheet is open.

viewportNote: Same markup and same null attributes at both widths, so this is not phone-only, but it was found and verified on the phone layout.

closestIssues.whyDifferent: contrast and heading order, not dialogs
invisible tab stops in the tab bar

notTested: real VoiceOver/TalkBack session (claim is based on missing ARIA attributes, not a screen reader run)
signed-in flows where more sheets exist
